How we work

Steps & timeline

01

Script

Week 1

We write a script that hooks in 3 seconds and delivers your message in 30–90 seconds.

02

Storyboard

Week 1–2

We create frame-by-frame storyboards and style frames for approval.

03

Animate

Week 2–4

We design and animate every frame — typography, illustration, and 3D elements.

04

Deliver

Week 4–5

We deliver in all formats — vertical, square, horizontal — ready for every platform.
